interface.longDescription: Isolate speech from background noise, music and non-voice sounds in an attached MP3 or WAV recording up to 20 MB. Listen in the inline audio player and use Open or Download. Cleanup can introduce artifacts; missing words cannot be recovered reliably. This does not clone voices or provide transcripts. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Clean the background noise from this recording.
Isolate the spoken voice in this audio.

positive.prompt: Clean the background noise from this speech recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept WAV, return actual cleaned audioUrl and generationId with playable inline audio.

positive.description: Attach a supported MP3 speech sample.
positive.prompt: Isolate the spoken voice in this MP3.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept MP3 and return an audio result with Open and Download; do not promise missing-word recovery.

positive.description: Provide a supported WAV through its actual HTTPS URL.
